title: PartiCam: Camera Controlled Video Generation with Reward Guidance
title_zh: PartiCam：基于奖励引导的相机控制视频生成

paragraphs.en: We present PartiCam , a training-free Parti cle filtering rooted method for improved Cam era controlled video generation. Generating videos that follow a precisely specified camera trajectory remains challenging for large video diffusion models. Training-free approaches are backbone-agnostic and avoid the need to construct large camera-annotated datasets by steering pretrained models toward the desired camera motion at test time. This enables the generation of camera-controlled video data that can subsequently be used to train camera-conditioned video diffusion models. Existing sampling-based guidance approaches often suffer from unstable trajectories: they either explore too broadly and fail to respect the target camera motion or collapse early and lose visual diversity over time. We introduce a global–local refinement framework for diffusion reward guidance, enabling accurate and consistent camera control during video generation. Our method builds on Sequential Monte-Carlo (SMC) guidance, but introduces a local refinement stage based on particle filtered resampling. Experiments show large improvements in camera trajectory adherence, reduced drift, and better visual quality, without requiring model retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PartiCam，这是一种无需训练的、基于粒子滤波的相机控制视频生成方法。 对于大型视频扩散模型而言，生成严格遵循指定相机轨迹的视频仍然具有挑战性。 无需训练的方法不依赖特定骨干网络，并且通过在测试时将预训练模型引导至所需的相机运动，避免了构建大规模带相机标注的数据集的需求。 这使得能够生成受相机控制的视频数据，这些数据随后可用于训练带有相机条件的视频扩散模型。 现有的基于采样的引导方法通常存在轨迹不稳定的问题：它们要么探索范围过广而未能遵循目标相机运动，要么过早收敛并随时间失去视觉多样性。 我们引入了一种全局-局部优化框架用于扩散奖励引导，从而在视频生成过程中实现准确且一致的相机控制。 我们的方法基于序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）引导，但引入了一个基于粒子滤波重采样的局部优化阶段。 实验表明，该方法无需重新训练模型，即可显著提升相机轨迹的遵循度、减少漂移并改善视觉质量。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in multimodal generation via diffusion and flow models have revolutionized creative fields, giving rise to video generation models [ 18 , 53 , 55 , 11 , 83 ] of impressive quality alongside emerging zero-shot generalization capabilities [ 68 ] . Yet these models often lack fine-grained control mechanisms. Building generation models that are action-conditioned, causally and physically controllable, and 3D-grounded represents a key step toward the vision of comprehensive world models. Open-source latent video models such as SVD [ 7 ] , CogVideo [ 33 , 75 ] , Wan [ 67 ] , and Hunyuan [ 41 ] , etc . provide a practical and manageable testbed for developing ideas that can scale to larger models and broader modalities.

paragraphs.en: Among the most important axes of control in visual data is camera viewpoint, which accounts for a dominant source of variation in images and videos and arguably offers the most intuitive form of control for these modalities. The task of camera trajectory control in video generation from a single reference image, sparse views, or a few frames of a dynamic scene is closely analogous to few-shot novel view synthesis [ 48 , 37 ] : the video model serves as a spatio-temporal prior that enables educated completion of unobserved viewpoints. The notorious difficulty of these tasks in classical computer vision and graphics underscores their inherent challenges, chief among them ensuring 3D and 4D scene consistency alongside photorealistic inpainting of occluded regions. Camera control can be achieved by training conditional models from scratch or via adapter like fine-tuning [ 29 , 82 ] . However, the scarcity of large-scale paired supervision, prohibitive computational training costs, and out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization failures on challenging geometries or novel camera trajectories can make such approaches expensive or suboptimal. A further, more practical concern is obsolescence: open-source latent video models are evolving rapidly, and a control module fine-tuned for one backbone is bound to that backbone’s architecture, latent space, and conditioning interface, so it risks being superseded before it is widely adopted. Training-free methods, by contrast, are largely backbone-agnostic and inherit the improvements of each new generation of base models at no additional training cost.
paragraphs.zh: 在视觉数据中，最重要的控制维度之一是相机视角，它是图像和视频变异的显著来源，并且可以说为这些模态提供了最直观的控制方式。 从单张参考图像、稀疏视角或动态场景的少数帧生成视频时，相机轨迹控制任务与少样本新视角合成 [48, 37] 极为相似：视频模型充当时空先验，从而能够合理补全未观测到的视角。 这些任务在经典计算机视觉和图形学中的极高难度凸显了其内在挑战，其中首要问题是如何确保三维和四维场景的一致性，同时实现被遮挡区域的逼真修复。 相机控制可以通过从头训练条件模型，或通过类似适配器的微调 [29, 82] 来实现。 然而，大规模配对监督数据的稀缺性、高昂的计算训练成本，以及在复杂几何结构或新型相机轨迹上出现的分布外（OOD）泛化失败，可能使这类方法代价高昂或效果次优。 另一个更具实际意义的担忧是过时问题：开源的潜在视频模型正在快速演进，而为某一主干模型微调的控制模块必然与该主干模型的架构、潜在空间和条件接口绑定，因此可能在广泛采用之前就被取代。 相比之下，无需训练的方法在很大程度上与具体主干模型无关，并且能够继承每一代基础模型的新改进，而无需产生额外的训练成本。

paragraphs.en: This motivates training-free, test-time alternatives, which have become an increasingly active direction. Beyond their immediate utility, we argue that such methods are also a prerequisite for the training-based approaches they appear to compete with: a reliable test-time procedure is a generator of paired camera-annotated video data, whose samples can be distilled back into model weights. This mirrors the trajectory of LLM post-training, where sampling from a model and fine-tuning on the verified subset, i.e . rejection sampling fine-tuning [ 85 , 84 , 60 ] , converts an expensive inference-time procedure into cheap model capability, and where the filter proved far easier to construct than the generator.
paragraphs.zh: 这推动了无需训练的测试时替代方案的发展，这些方案已成为一个日益活跃的研究方向。 除了其直接的实用价值之外，我们认为这类方法也是它们所竞争的基于训练的方法的先决条件：一种可靠的测试时流程能够生成带有相机标注的成对视频数据，而这些数据的样本可以被蒸馏回模型权重中。 这与大型语言模型（LLM）训练后的发展路径相似：从模型中采样并在经过验证的子集上进行微调（即拒绝采样微调 [85, 84, 60]），将昂贵的推理时流程转化为廉价的模型能力，而其中的过滤步骤被证明比生成步骤更容易构建。

paragraphs.en: One of the established approaches to training-free camera control is score modulation ( e.g . [ 78 ] ): at each denoising step, the score function is adjusted using warped input views as scene priors, steering the latent trajectory toward the target camera pose. We build on this formulation without loss of generality as our underlying control mechanism. Despite its effectiveness, score modulation operates over a single denoising trajectory. Errors made early in sampling, when an unlucky noise realization places the model on a poor generative path, compound through subsequent steps and become increasingly difficult to correct, leading to persistent camera drift even as the number of inference steps increases.
paragraphs.zh: 一种成熟的免训练相机控制方法是分数调制（例如： [ 78 ]）：在每个去噪步骤中，利用经过形变的输入视图作为场景先验来调整分数函数，从而引导潜在轨迹朝向目标相机姿态。 我们将此公式作为基础控制机制，同时不损失其普适性。 尽管分数调制方法有效，但它仅针对单一的去噪轨迹进行操作。 在采样早期阶段出现的错误——当运气不佳的噪声实现将模型置于较差的生成路径上时——会在后续步骤中不断累积，且越来越难以纠正，最终导致即使推理步数增加，相机漂移问题依然存在。

paragraphs.en: One natural remedy is to introduce stochastic restarts [ 73 ] during sampling: by re-injecting forward-diffusion noise into an intermediate latent and re-denoising, the model is given an opportunity to escape poor generative trajectories and recover camera consistency. However, unrestricted restarts are unstable in practice and can severely degrade generation quality by discarding useful structure accumulated during denoising. To stabilize restarts, we propose equipping them with reward-guided resampling : at each restart, we draw N N perturbed candidate continuations via noising-denoising, score each against a camera alignment reward, and retain the best according to these scores. Our formulation can support both differentiable and non-differentiable reward functions, enabling flexible integration of arbitrary camera consistency or visual quality metrics. This local procedure, which we term PF-Restart, substantially improves trajectory coherence. Yet because it operates independently for each candidate, it provides no mechanism to leverage a broader population of trajectories for global exploration, and is therefore still susceptible to collective drift when all candidates enter a similarly poor region of latent space.
paragraphs.zh: 一种自然的方法是在采样过程中引入随机重启 [73]：通过向中间潜在空间重新注入前向扩散噪声并再次去噪，模型便有机会摆脱较差的生成轨迹，并恢复相机一致性。 然而，不受限制的重启在实践中并不稳定，并且可能因丢弃去噪过程中积累的有效结构而严重降低生成质量。 为了稳定重启过程，我们提出为其引入奖励引导的重采样机制：在每次重启时，我们通过噪声注入与去噪生成 N 个扰动后的候选延续，根据相机对齐奖励对每个候选进行评分，并依据这些评分保留最佳结果。 我们的方法既支持可微分奖励函数，也支持不可微分奖励函数，从而能够灵活地整合任意的相机一致性或视觉质量指标。 我们将这一局部过程称为 PF-Restart，它能显著提升轨迹的连贯性。 然而，由于该过程对每个候选独立执行，因此无法利用更广泛的轨迹集合进行全局探索；当所有候选都进入潜在空间中相似的不良区域时，它仍然容易受到集体漂移的影响。

paragraphs.en: We address this by embedding local PF-Restart within a global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) framework. Rather than steering a single trajectory, our method maintains a population of K K candidate video trajectories ( i.e . particles) which are jointly propagated through the denoising process and globally reweighted and resampled according to how well they satisfy the target camera trajectory and desired visual properties. High-reward particles are preferentially retained and diversified via local PF-Restart restarts, whereas low-reward ones are discarded, giving the sampler a principled mechanism to continuously reallocate compute toward geometrically coherent and visually appealing trajectories. This combination of global population filtering and local reward-guided refinement empirically mitigates early drift, avoids collapse into low-quality or geometrically inconsistent solutions, and preserves sample diversity – limitations that plague both score modulation and unrestricted restart strategies individually. Importantly, our method is not limited to the training-free setting: it can be applied on top of trained camera control baselines ( e.g . [ 29 , 82 ] ), mitigating some of their OOD generalization failures on challenging geometries or out-of-distribution trajectories.

paragraphs.en: Denoising diffusion probabilistic models [ 31 ] and efficient samplers such as DDIM [ 58 ] and DPM-Solver [ 45 ] have become the dominant generative paradigm for images and video, with latent diffusion models [ 57 ] enabling scalable high-resolution synthesis. Training-based controlled generation paradigms including ControlNet [ 87 ] , IP-Adapter [ 76 ] , T2I-Adapter [ 50 ] , and classifier-free guidance [ 32 ] require paired training data and considerable computational resources. In contrast, training-free Guidance enable control without parameter update and with fractional cost. Inference-time steering of diffusion models generally falls into three categories: noise/attention manipulation, gradient-based guidance, and particle filtering. Attention-based methods ( e.g . [ 34 , 42 , 1 , 30 , 49 ] ) are effective for image and video editing but difficult to adapt to complex geometric 3D constraints. Gradient-based methods ( e.g . [ pseudoinverse , 16 , 81 , 5 ] ) utilize auxiliary energy functions to steer the denoising process. DPS [ 13 ] , for instance injects differentiable likelihoods directly into the reverse process. However, computing gradients through a video diffusion model at every step is computationally expensive and prone to high variance. Our method belongs to the third category, using reward-weighted Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to steer the generation without requiring expensive gradient backpropagation.
paragraphs.zh: 去噪扩散概率模型 [ 31 ] 以及高效的采样器（如 DDIM [ 58 ] 和 DPM-Solver [ 45 ]）已成为图像和视频生成领域的主流范式，而潜在扩散模型 [ 57 ] 则实现了可扩展的高分辨率合成。 基于训练的受控生成范式（包括 ControlNet [ 87 ]、IP-Adapter [ 76 ]、T2I-Adapter [ 50 ] 和无分类器引导 [ 32 ]）需要成对的训练数据和大量的计算资源。 相比之下，无需训练的引导方法能够在不更新参数的情况下实现控制，且成本极低。 扩散模型在推理阶段的引导通常分为三类：噪声/注意力操控、基于梯度的引导和粒子滤波。 基于注意力的方法（例如： [ 34 , 42 , 1 , 30 , 49 ]）对图像和视频编辑效果显著，但难以适应复杂的几何三维约束。 基于梯度的方法（例如： [ pseudoinverse , 16 , 81 , 5 ]）利用辅助能量函数来引导去噪过程。 例如，DPS [ 13 ] 将可微分的似然值直接注入到反向过程中。 然而，在每一步都通过视频扩散模型计算梯度会消耗大量计算资源，且容易产生高方差。 我们的方法属于第三类，它使用奖励加权的序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法引导生成过程，而无需昂贵的梯度反向传播。

paragraphs.en: Song et al . [ 59 ] establish predictor-corrector samplers under the SDE framework, showing that mid-trajectory Langevin corrections reduce deviation from the data manifold. CCDF [ 15 ] enforces conditioning via partial forward–reverse noise cycles, and MCG [ 14 ] projects corrector steps onto the data manifold. paragraphs.en: A growing body of work frames conditional diffusion as reward alignment via Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) [ 22 , 19 ] , motivated by the shift toward post-training optimisation [ 62 ] . Tweedie’s formula [ 23 ] enables reward evaluation throughout the denoising chain without model updates. TDS [ 70 ] constructs twisted proposals targeting a reward-weighted posterior; Dou and Song [ 21 ] connect DPS to exact Kalman filtering. Kim et al . [ 39 ] combine SMC with adaptive resampling to avoid reward over-optimisation, and Kim et al . [ 38 ] scale inference-time compute for flow models. Ψ \Psi -Sampler [ 77 ] shows that Gaussian prior initialisation wastes particle diversity in low-reward regions, and proposes pCNL as a dimension-robust, gradient-informed MCMC sampler to draw initial particles from the reward-aware posterior, yielding consistent gains on layout, counting, and aesthetic tasks. SMC has also been applied to protein design [ 61 ] and language decoding [ 51 ] . Training-based aligners such as DPOK [ 25 ] , DDPO [ 6 ] , and RAFT [ 20 ] require parameter updates and are orthogonal to our approach. Our global SMC stage builds on TDS weighting and shares Ψ \Psi -Sampler’s motivation of targeting reward-relevant regions early in the chain, extended to the video latent space for camera trajectory alignment.

paragraphs.en: Stand-alone models like NeRF [ 48 ] and 3DGS [ 37 ] can learn scene-specific 3D representations renderable from any viewpoint given calibrated multi-view images. Dynamic versions can render dynamic scenes [ 46 , 69 , 56 , 54 ] by modeling typically a canonical 3D and deformation fields jointly. Data and regularization priors result in versions that are less likely to break under sparse input views [ 52 , 74 , 79 , 10 , 72 , 9 , 12 ] . However, reconstruction-based approaches are limited to observed geometry and struggle with large viewpoint extrapolation or disocclusions. Some of these limitations can be mitigated with hybrid methods distilling image or video diffusion priors into explicit 3D representations [ 64 , 2 , 44 ] . Feed-forward multi-view diffusion models synthesize new viewpoints from one or few images [ 63 , 27 , 8 , 24 , 43 ] . While requiring costly multi-view training data, many remain restricted to static or short-baseline settings with limited temporal consistency.

paragraphs.en: We propose a probabilistic control framework for diffusion-based video generation models, designed to steer the generation process toward a desired camera trajectory. Our method operates in the latent space of the diffusion model, maintaining and refining a population of stochastic trajectories. The procedure combines a global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) component for trajectory exploration and a local refinement component that merges particle filtering with Restarts [ 47 , 73 , 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种基于扩散模型的视频生成概率控制框架，旨在引导生成过程朝向预期的相机轨迹发展。 我们的方法在扩散模型的潜在空间中运行，同时维持并优化一组随机轨迹。 该流程结合了用于轨迹探索的全局顺序蒙特卡洛（SMC）组件，以及将粒子滤波与重启机制 [ 47 , 73 , 4 ] 相结合的局部优化组件。

paragraphs.en: A fundamental limitation of Score Modulation methods is that errors made early in sampling compound and become difficult to correct later, even when increasing the number of inference steps. When the early noise realization places sampling on a poor generative trajectory, the model often remains trapped there, resulting in camera drift confirmed by high ATE scores in our experiments (see Table 2 ). One way to mitigate this problem efficiently is to introduce stochastic perturbations in the form of Restarts [ 73 ] during sampling to recover correct camera trajectories by escaping such failure modes. Yet, in practice, unrestricted restarts are unstable and can degrade generation quality. To stabilize this mechanism, we propose to incorporate inference-time alignment [ 62 ] and convert the stochastic exploration into a structured filtering procedure.
paragraphs.zh: Score Modulation 方法的一个根本性局限在于，采样早期出现的错误会不断累积，导致后期难以纠正，即使增加推理步数也难以改善。 当早期的噪声实现将采样引导至较差的生成轨迹时，模型通常会陷入其中，从而导致相机漂移；我们的实验通过较高的 ATE 分数证实了这一点（参见表 2）。 有效缓解这一问题的方法之一，是在采样过程中引入以“重启”[73] 形式表现的随机扰动，从而摆脱此类失效模式，恢复正确的相机轨迹。 然而，在实践中，不受限制的重启机制并不稳定，甚至可能降低生成质量。 为了稳定这一机制，我们提出在推理阶段引入对齐机制 [62]，并将随机探索转化为一种结构化的过滤流程。

paragraphs.en: We employ Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) as an inference-time guidance mechanism. SMC naturally filters trajectory candidates by assigning each particle an importance weight derived from the reward and resampling the population so that high-reward trajectories, i.e . those consistent with the target camera motion and desired visual quality, are preferentially retained. This filtering is applied globally across a population of particles throughout the diffusion process, allowing the sampler to continuously steer generation toward trajectories that remain both geometrically coherent and visually appealing. In parallel, each particle undergoes a local restart procedure: from its latent state 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t} , we draw N r N_{r} perturbations by injecting forward-diffusion noise and then denoise each one back to time t t . These proposals constitute a local candidate set on which we again apply reward-weighted resampling during the backward update. The combination of global population filtering and local restart-based refinement mitigates early drift, avoids collapse into low-quality or geometrically inconsistent trajectories, and yields temporally stable video samples that follow the prescribed motion while maintaining high aesthetic fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将顺序蒙特卡洛（SMC）用作推理时的引导机制。 SMC 通过为每个粒子分配一个由奖励值推导出的重要性权重来自然地筛选轨迹候选，并对粒子群进行重采样，从而优先保留高奖励的轨迹，即那些与目标相机运动和期望视觉质量一致的轨迹。 在整个扩散过程中，这种筛选会全局应用于整个粒子群，使采样器能够持续引导生成过程，朝向既保持几何一致性又具有视觉吸引力的轨迹发展。 与此同时，每个粒子都会经历一个局部重启过程：从其潜在状态 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t} 出发，我们通过注入前向扩散噪声生成 N r N_{r} 个扰动，然后对每个扰动进行去噪，使其返回时间 t t 。 这些提议构成了一个局部候选集，我们在反向更新过程中再次对该集合应用基于奖励权重的重采样。 全局粒子群筛选与基于局部重启的优化相结合，能够缓解早期漂移，避免陷入低质量或几何不一致的轨迹，并生成在时间上稳定的视频样本——这些样本既遵循了预设的运动，又保持了高水准的视觉保真度。

paragraphs.en: Our method consists of two complementary components: a local refinement module (PF-Restart) and a global exploration module based on Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC). The local refinement step corrects camera trajectories through restart operations combined with reward-guided resampling, while the global component maintains a set of reward-weighted trajectories that are periodically resampled to preserve diversity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法由两个互补的组件组成：一个局部优化模块（PF-Restart）和一个基于序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）的全局探索模块。 局部优化步骤通过重启操作与奖励引导的重采样相结合来修正相机轨迹，而全局组件则维护一组带有奖励权重的轨迹，并定期对其进行重采样以保持多样性。

sents.en: The local refinement step corrects camera trajectories through restart operations combined with reward-guided resampling, while the global component maintains a set of reward-weighted trajectories that are periodically resampled to preserve diversity.

paragraphs.en: For local refinement, we use the camera reward , as this stage is specifically designed to correct the camera trajectory. In contrast, the global SMC exploration relies on the aesthetic reward . As shown in our ablations, this separation provides a favorable trade-off between aesthetic quality and camera accuracy.

paragraphs.en: Our reward-guided sampling strategy consistently improves camera accuracy compared to existing approaches. In particular, methods such as NVS-Solver (training-free) and MotionCtrl (training-based) often struggle to follow the target trajectory in the presence of scene dynamics and occlusions. In contrast, our method achieves substantially lower Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE), as well as lower relative pose errors (RPE-T and RPE-R), indicating more accurate and faithful recovery of the desired camera motion.
paragraphs.zh: 与现有方法相比，我们的奖励引导采样策略能持续提高摄像头的准确性。 特别是，像 NVS-Solver（无需训练）和 MotionCtrl（基于训练）这类方法在存在场景动态变化和遮挡时，往往难以跟随目标轨迹。 相比之下，我们的方法实现了显著更低的绝对轨迹误差（ATE），以及更低的相对位姿误差（RPE-T 和 RPE-R），表明对期望摄像头运动的恢复更加准确且忠实。

sents.en: Our reward-guided sampling strategy consistently improves camera accuracy compared to existing approaches.
sents.zh: 与现有方法相比，我们的奖励引导采样策略能持续提高摄像头的准确性。

sents.en: In particular, methods such as NVS-Solver (training-free) and MotionCtrl (training-based) often struggle to follow the target trajectory in the presence of scene dynamics and occlusions.
sents.zh: 特别是，像 NVS-Solver（无需训练）和 MotionCtrl（基于训练）这类方法在存在场景动态变化和遮挡时，往往难以跟随目标轨迹。

sents.en: In contrast, our method achieves substantially lower Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE), as well as lower relative pose errors (RPE-T and RPE-R), indicating more accurate and faithful recovery of the desired camera motion.
sents.zh: 相比之下，我们的方法实现了显著更低的绝对轨迹误差（ATE），以及更低的相对位姿误差（RPE-T 和 RPE-R），表明对期望摄像头运动的恢复更加准确且忠实。

paragraphs.en: Beyond trajectory accuracy, our approach also improves the visual quality of the generated videos. By exploring multiple candidate trajectories during sampling and reallocating computation toward high-reward solutions, the method better handles disocclusions and dynamic regions. As a result, the generated videos exhibit sharper structures, more consistent geometry, and fewer motion artifacts, leading to more realistic and temporally coherent renderings.
paragraphs.zh: 除了轨迹准确性之外，我们的方法还提升了生成视频的视觉质量。 通过在采样过程中探索多个候选轨迹，并将计算资源重新分配给高奖励的解决方案，该方法能更好地处理遮挡和动态区域。 因此，生成的视频展现出更清晰的结构、更一致的几何形态以及更少的运动伪影，从而实现了更真实且时间上连贯的渲染效果。

paragraphs.en: We conduct an ablative analysis on the static scenes from the NVS-Solver benchmark [ 78 ] using right-sweep trajectories, evaluating each component of our method using ATE, RPE-T, RPE-R, and FID. Results are summarised in Figure 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用右扫轨迹对 NVS-Solver 基准测试 [78] 中的静态场景进行了消融分析，并通过 ATE、RPE-T、RPE-R 和 FID 评估了我们方法中的每个组件。 结果汇总于图 5 中。

sents.zh: 我们使用右扫轨迹对 NVS-Solver 基准测试 [78] 中的静态场景进行了消融分析，并通过 ATE、RPE-T、RPE-R 和 FID 评估了我们方法中的每个组件。

sents.en: Results are summarised in Figure 5 .

paragraphs.en: Starting from the NVS-Solver baseline (ATE: 1.56, RPE-T: 0.52, RPE-R: 0.27, FID: 133.96), introducing a simple restart without reward guidance already yields meaningful improvements across all metrics (ATE: 1.09, RPE-T: 0.27, RPE-R: 0.24, FID: 117.07). However, as evidenced by the wide interquartile ranges in Figure 5 , plain restart suffers from high variance across scenes: while some scenes benefit substantially, others show little or no improvement. This indicates that without any reward signal to guide resampling, noise injection makes the generation process unstable.
paragraphs.zh: 以 NVS-Solver 基线模型（ATE：1.56，RPE-T：0.52，RPE-R：0.27，FID：133.96）为起点，仅引入一个无奖励引导的简单重启机制，便已在所有指标上带来了显著改进（ATE：1.09，RPE-T：0.27，RPE-R：0.24，FID：117.07）。 然而，如图 5 中宽大的四分位距范围所示，单纯的重启机制在不同场景间存在较大的方差：某些场景能从中获益显著，而另一些场景则几乎没有改进。 这表明，在没有奖励信号引导重新采样的情况下，噪声注入会使生成过程变得不稳定。

paragraphs.en: Incorporating reward-guided resampling into the restart procedure (PF-Restart) significantly tightens this variance while further improving trajectory accuracy. With N r = 2 N_{r}=2 local candidates, PF-Restart reduces ATE to 0.76 and RPE-T to 0.17 . Increasing to N r = 4 N_{r}=4 pushes these to 0.54 and 0.14 respectively, while maintaining FID at 114.15 in both settings. Compared to unguided restart, the reward-guided resampling yields a notably more compact distribution of per-scene errors, confirming that reward alignment stabilizes the local search.
paragraphs.zh: 将奖励引导的重采样整合到重启流程（PF-Restart）中，能显著缩小这种方差，同时进一步提升轨迹准确性。 当 N r = 2 N_{r}=2 个局部候选方案时，PF-Restart 将 ATE 降至 0.76，RPE-T 降至 0.17。 将 N r 增至 4 N_{r}=4 时，这两个指标分别降至 0.54 和 0.14，同时两种设置下的 FID 均保持在 114.15。 与无引导的重启相比，奖励引导的重采样能产生明显更紧凑的场景级误差分布，证实了奖励对齐能够稳定局部搜索。

paragraphs.en: Global Sequential Monte Carlo sampling alone (K=4) reduces ATE to 1.03 and RPE-R to 0.19, but fails to achieve satisfactory performance on translation accuracy (RPE-T: 0.31 ) and actually degrades FID relative to NVS-Solver (135.84 vs. 133.96). This counterintuitive finding highlights a fundamental limitation of population-level exploration without local correction: while global diversity prevents early collapse into poor basins, it does not provide the fine-grained per-particle guidance needed to correct individual trajectory errors. This result confirms that global SMC alone is insufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用全局顺序蒙特卡洛采样（K=4）将 ATE 降至 1.03，RPE-R 降至 0.19，但在翻译准确率方面未能达到令人满意的表现（RPE-T：0.31），并且与 NVS-Solver 相比，FID 反而有所下降（135.84 对比 133.96）。 这一反直觉的发现揭示了在没有局部修正的情况下进行群体级探索的一个根本性局限：尽管全局多样性可以防止过早陷入较差的优化区域，但它无法提供每个粒子所需的精细引导来纠正个体轨迹中的错误。 这一结果证实了仅靠全局 SMC 是不足够的。

paragraphs.en: Combining global SMC with local PF-Restart, our full method achieves the best overall performance and validates the complementarity of the two mechanisms. With K = 2 K=2 and N r = 2 N_{r}=2 , using the aesthetic reward for global exploration and the camera reward for local refinement, the joint method reaches RPE-T: 0.09 , RPE-R: 0.09, ATE: 0.37, and FID: 103.82, which is a 6× reduction in translation error and 4× reduction in ATE relative to NVS-Solver, while simultaneously improving visual quality. Increasing N r N_{r} to 4 does not monotonically help: ATE slightly degrades from 0.37 to 0.46 and RPE-R worsens from 0.09° to 0.14°, suggesting that local restarting with more particle budget can undermine global trajectory consistency when the control signal is not strong enough. The sweet spot in our setting is K = 2 K=2 , N r = 2 N_{r}=2 .
paragraphs.zh: 通过将全局 SMC 与局部 PF-Restart 相结合，我们的完整方法实现了最佳的整体性能，并验证了这两种机制的互补性。 在 K = 2、N r = 2 的情况下，使用美学奖励进行全局探索，并使用相机奖励进行局部优化，联合方法达到了 RPE-T: 0.09、RPE-R: 0.09、ATE: 0.37 和 FID: 103.82，与 NVS-Solver 相比，翻译误差降低了 6 倍，ATE 降低了 4 倍，同时视觉质量也得到了提升。 将 N r 增加到 4 并未带来单调的改善：ATE 从 0.37 轻微下降至 0.46，RPE-R 也从 0.09° 恶化至 0.14°，这表明当控制信号不够强时，使用更多粒子预算的局部重启可能会破坏全局轨迹的一致性。 在我们设定的参数中，最佳组合是 K = 2、N r = 2。

paragraphs.en: A crucial choice for our method is the choice of the reward function we use to guide the sampling. We experimented in the paper with camera error using VGGT [ 65 ] to estimate trajectories in addition to aesthetic reward used in [ 36 ] . In our default configuration, the global stage uses the aesthetic reward to preserve visual diversity across particles, while the local stage uses the camera reward to correct geometric drift. We additionally evaluate a variant where the camera reward drives both stages ( K = 2 K=2 , N r = 4 N_{r}=4 ). Replacing the aesthetic reward with the camera reward in the global SMC yields the best absolute ATE of 0.28: a further 24% improvement over the aesthetic-global variant at the same N r N_{r} and also improves RPE-R from 0.14 to 0.11 relative to the aesthetic variant. This comes at a minor cost in visual quality (FID: 103.06 vs. 102.51) and a slight regression in RPE-R relative to the K = 2 K=2 , N r = 2 N_{r}=2 default (0.11 vs. 0.09). These results reveal a clear trade-off: using the camera reward globally sharpens trajectory adherence but reduces the diversity of particle proposals. The default separation with aesthetic reward globally and camera reward locally provides a good balance between geometric accuracy and visual quality, and is the configuration adopted throughout our main experiments. Similarly, we can see that for SCG using the camera reward significantly improves the camera metrics (ATE: 1.49 vs 1.25). For PF-Restart, we noted that they both perform equally well for scenes without large occlusion as in this case the quality of the video is enough to guide the model to generate meaningful content in the occluded regions. However when the motion is ambiguous due to large occlusions, Camera reward shows significantly better results improving the Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) from 1.00 to 0.71.
paragraphs.zh: 我们方法中的一个关键选择是，如何选取用于指导采样的奖励函数。 在论文中，我们实验性地使用了 VGGT [65] 来估计轨迹的相机误差，此外还采用了 [36] 中使用的美学奖励。 在我们的默认配置中，全局阶段使用美学奖励以维持粒子之间的视觉多样性，而局部阶段则使用相机奖励来修正几何漂移。 我们还评估了一种变体，其中相机奖励驱动两个阶段（K = 2, N_r = 4）。 在全局 SMC 中将美学奖励替换为相机奖励，可获得最佳的绝对轨迹误差（ATE）0.28：与相同 N_r 的美学-全局变体相比，这进一步提升了 24%，并且相对于美学变体，RPE-R 也从 0.14 改善到了 0.11。 但这一改进以轻微的视觉质量代价为代价（FID：103.06 对比 102.51），并且在 RPE-R 上相较于 K = 2、N_r = 2 的默认配置略有下降（0.11 对比 0.09）。 这些结果揭示了一个明确的权衡：全局使用相机奖励能增强对轨迹的遵循性，但会减少粒子提案的多样性。 默认配置中，全局使用美学奖励、局部使用相机奖励，在几何精度与视觉质量之间实现了良好的平衡，这也是我们在主要实验中采用的配置。 类似地，我们可以看出，对于 SCG，使用相机奖励显著提升了相机指标（ATE：1.49 对比 1.25）。 对于 PF-Restart，我们注意到，在没有大遮挡的场景中，两种方法表现相当；在这种情况下，视频质量足以引导模型在遮挡区域生成有意义的内容。 然而，当由于大遮挡导致运动模糊时，相机奖励展现出显著更好的效果，将绝对轨迹误差（ATE）从 1.00 改善到了 0.71。

paragraphs.en: These methods differ in how they estimate reward, how they sample candidate trajectories, and how they select the best samples. We seek a method that can quickly explore the space of diffusion trajectories and accurately select the best ones. TDS [ 70 ] and Ψ \Psi -Sampler [ 77 ] are the closest to our method but they require differentiating through the reward function and to backpropagate through the diffusion model which is impractical for reward functions like the camera reward and recent video diffusion models like Cog-Video or Wan. On the other hand, SCG [ 35 ] has the advantage of maintaining one global particle and sampling candidates using the reverse SDE which results in less diverse samples throughout the iterations. With aesthetic reward it performs the worst of all evaluated configurations on trajectory metrics (RPE-T: 0.71, ATE: 1.49), confirming that a non-geometric reward is insufficient to guide camera-accurate generation under this sampler. SCG with camera reward recovers partially (RPE-T: 0.25, ATE: 1.25) but still falls far behind our full method. Consequently, beyond the choice of the reward, our approach lies in the bi-level SMC framework itself: global exploration and local reward-guided refinement together achieve what neither component nor SCG can accomplish alone.

paragraphs.en: We presented PartiCam, a training-free framework for improving camera trajectory control in diffusion-based video generation. Our approach combines global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) trajectory exploration with local particle-filtered restarts (PF–Restart), enabling reward-guided sampling that balances exploration and refinement during the denoising process. This formulation mitigates common failure modes of existing approaches, including early trajectory drift in score-modulated sampling and limited robustness to OOD camera motions. By maintaining a population of candidate trajectories and reallocating sampling effort toward high-reward solutions, our method produces videos that better adhere to the desired camera trajectory while maintaining visual quality and temporal coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PartiCam，一个无需训练的框架，用于改进基于扩散模型的视频生成中的相机轨迹控制。 我们的方法将全局的序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）轨迹探索与局部粒子滤波重启（PF–Restart）相结合，实现了奖励引导的采样，在去噪过程中平衡了探索与优化。 这种设计缓解了现有方法的常见失效模式，包括分数调制采样中的早期轨迹漂移以及对域外（OOD）相机运动的鲁棒性不足。 通过维持一组候选轨迹，并将采样资源重新分配给高奖励的解决方案，我们的方法生成的视频能更好地遵循期望的相机轨迹，同时保持视觉质量和时间连贯性。

paragraphs.en: Beyond camera control, the proposed framework provides a general mechanism for reward-guided steering of diffusion processes without requiring gradient backpropagation or model retraining. We believe this population-based inference strategy may extend naturally to other controlled generation tasks and forms a promising direction for future work.
